summary: Frontend-only test of the My Tests exam tabs and Misfire Mocks, using the QA learner READ ONLY. Every non-GET under /api/jl outside /auth was stopped in the browser, and Misfire try/done got fake answers in the browser. BLOCKED was [] in every run except my own test that the Compare POST is wired, and PAGEERRORS was [] everywhere. The main agent's script misfire_mock_check.py at 360px passed 24/24. My new scripts: misfire_mock_edge_check.py 38/40 at 390px and 37/40 at 360px (the misses are 1 untestable case with this account's data and 1-2 cut-off labels); misfire_mock_short_check.py 6/6; misfire_mock_sync_check.py 4/4; my_tests_tabs_check.py 5/5. Ad-hoc Playwright checks found 1 real bug: mock numbers repeat ('Misfire Mock #1' twice) when the new-mock screen is opened before the mocks list has loaded. Everything asked for works: My Tests has exactly 4 exam tabs with the selected one red and no outcome chips, the tabs filter website papers and mocks, and Completed/In progress/Saved, Compare (POST stopped by the test), Open result and search all work. On the new-mock screen: pool counts match Misfire (235/237/203 = 675 open), subject tabs use the Student Choice colours, count tabs are red when picked, the 25 cap and stepper work, select-all and multi-chapter selection work, and unticking every chapter shows the hint and sets the count to 0. Timing is right (25 Phy = 1 hr, 5 Phy = 12, 5 Chem = 8, 3 Maths = 10, 5 Phy + 5 Maths = 28, 13 questions = 30 min). Building shows a progress sheet and opens the ready screen. When fewer questions are found than asked (stand-in: results with questions marked dropped), the mock uses what it got (4 of 20) and shows the notice; it is still there after a reload. When nothing usable is found, an error sheet shows with Retry and Close. 'Is mock ko hatao' removes the mock; its URL then shows a 'not on this phone' message. In the player: timer, Clear, Mark for review, palette, exit sheet (Stay / Leave keeps answers) and resume from In progress all work. Clock expiry works both inside the player and when the mock is opened later (browser clock moved forward). On the result screen: score ring, Sahi/Galat/Chhode, subject-wise card, filter tabs, question rail, your answer and the key, solution text and images, and the 'Asli paper ka result' and 'Naya mock banao' links all work. Right answers send exactly one try and one done each (8/8) and the result says 'N sawaal “Samajh gaya” mein chale gaye'. If the website is down, a waiting card with 'Abhi bhejo' shows; resending moves the rest, and an answer the website refuses counts as wrong. Signing out clears mocks. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: nextNumber() reads the in-memory `rows`, which only useMocks()/loadMocks() fill (My Tests and the Misfire > Mock tab). If /misfire/mock/new is opened before either has loaded the list, every new mock is numbered #1. Reproduced on fresh loads of /misfire/mock/new: two mocks both became 'Misfire Mock #1', and the next one became #2 instead of #3. Users can hit this in the app: cold start -> Misfire (Sab tab) -> 'Mock banao' CTA without visiting My Tests. Fix: `await loadMocks()` before `const n = nextNumber()` in buildMock (or make nextNumber async).

issues: Dock labels cut off: 'Mark for revi…' and, on the last question, 'Review & s…'
Palette sheet: 'Back to questi…' cut off. The paper player app/attempt/[id].tsx uses the same pattern, so this may be an existing look; the owner asked for no clipped labels at 360px
When nothing is picked, the hint is cut off at 360 and 390px: 'Har subject ke kitne sawaal, upar c…'
Question text drawn from the source picture is very small at 360-390px (about 6-7px text). The zoom button exists; consider a larger default reading size
The source line repeats the chapter for chapter-wise papers: '01 Units, Dimensions and Errors · Q10 · 01 Units, Dimensions and Errors'
The pill row scrolls so the selected 'Mock' pill sits flush against the left screen edge and 'Sab' is hidden; the selected pill is black, not blood-red (same PillRow style as the other Misfire tabs)
'Is mock ko hatao' deletes at once with no confirmation
The 'short' notice is generic; it could say per subject how many were asked and how many were found

action_items: Fix the repeated mock numbers: in src/misfire/mock/build.ts buildMock, await loadMocks() before nextNumber() (one line, small change)
Optional: stop dock and palette labels from being cut off at 360px in src/misfire/mock/Player.tsx (shorter labels such as 'Review' / 'Back', or smaller text)
Optional: make the bottom-bar hint on the new-mock screen shorter so it fits on one line
Optional: confirm before 'Is mock ko hatao'; stop the solution source line repeating the chapter
critical_code_review_comments: build.ts:135 nextNumber() depends on whether rows are loaded (bug above).

marking.ts sendRight: if try succeeds but done fails for a temporary reason (5xx/0/429), the question stays in todo and the next resend posts try again. That is more than one try for the same Misfire item on the website; harmless but not strictly 'once'.

store.ts addMock: MAX_KEPT = 40 silently drops the oldest mocks, including any with right answers still waiting to sync (sync.todo). Those answers will never reach 'Samajh gaya'. Signing out with sync waiting loses them the same way.

new.tsx: the pool comes from useCached(`${misfireKey}.mockpool`). If invalidate(misfireKey(uid)) in marking.ts does not also invalidate that key, the open counts stay out of date after a mock moves questions until the next reload. candidates() does filter out items fixed on the phone, so the mock itself is unaffected.
tests.tsx:124: the exam filter matches mocks by label (m.exam === 'JEE Main'), so 'Mixed' mocks only appear under All exams. This looks intended.

The UI caps each count at what the chosen chapters have, so the 'fewer than asked' notice only appears when some drawn questions cannot be used (result not released, bonus or dropped). This account has no chapter with fewer than 25 questions (smallest is Maths 37), so I tested the notice with stand-ins.
seed_data_creation: None. Mocks were made only in temporary browser contexts (encrypted IndexedDB on the device). Nothing was written to the website: every non-GET outside /auth was stopped in the browser; try/done were faked in the browser; POST /my/tests/compare was stopped (418) as part of my own test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run python3 /app/tests/misfire_mock_edge_check.py 360|390 (all READ ONLY guards included). Expected fails: 'small chapter' (no chapter below 25 in the QA account), the cut-off label checks, and 'player labels not clipped' at 360. After the nextNumber fix: open /misfire/mock/new on a fresh load twice and check the ready-screen titles are #1 then #2. Stand-in responses for try/done must include meta.api_version '1', otherwise the client counts the answers as refused.
rca_of_issue: Repeated mock numbers: buildMock computes n = nextNumber() from the module-level `rows`. That is still null when no list screen has called loadMocks() this session, so n = 1. addMock() then calls loadMocks() and puts the row at the top of the list, keeping the wrong number. To reproduce: fresh load of /misfire/mock/new, build, reload /misfire/mock/new, build again; both are 'Misfire Mock #1'. Fix: await loadMocks() at the start of buildMock (before nextNumber).
